notes.key: 11-story.md?match=Default::Tone rules (Default)::The characters joke; the world doesn't. Mum, the rival, townsfolk and the creatures' personalities carry the humour. Bleached reefs and empt
notes.item: The characters joke; the world doesn't. Mum, the rival, townsfolk and the creatures' personalities carry the humour. Bleached reefs and empty villages are shown straight.
notes.text: We don't need to try too hard with humor. Maybe we can try some jokes and see how it feels.

notes.key: 11-story.md?match=Default::Tone rules (Default)::Show the serious side, don't announce it. A keeper who guards a stone and can't remember why. A house on the ruined island with the table st
notes.item: Show the serious side, don't announce it. A keeper who guards a stone and can't remember why. A house on the ruined island with the table still set.
notes.text: Very important we show rather than tell. Story-telling 101
